notes.title: Patch v1.7 delivers full Steam Deck compatibility!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch 1.7 Highlights:[/b]

[b]Steam Deck Compatibility & Enhancements:[/b]

-[b]Full Steam Deck Support[/b]: Higher Than Mush is now fully compatible with the Steam Deck!
-[b]Play Anywhere[/b]: Enjoy the complete Higher Than Mush on the go.
-[b]SteamOS Performance Optimization[/b]: We've specifically optimized the game for improved performance and stability on SteamOS.

[b]General Gameplay Improvements & Fixes:[/b]

-[b]UI Fix (Leaderboard)[/b]: Resolved a UI bug that affected the leaderboard display, ensuring better clarity.
-[b]New Player Experience[/b]: Adjusted the difficulty at the beginning for a smoother onboarding experience for all players.

notes.title: Leaderboard Challenge: Top 100 Locked In!
notes.notes:
The global leaderboard's elite spots are now claimed! To break into the Top 100, new players will need to demonstrate truly exceptional skill and push their limits!

Can you reach the top? How high can the scores go?

Your support helps our community grow! Please consider leaving a review to help us reach more players.

Thank you for playing!

From Olimo solo dev
